BMEA.name: Biomea Fusion, Inc.
BMEA.catalyst: Phase 1/2 diabetes safety update and clinical data readout.
BMEA.thesis: Biomea experienced a steep 3-day technical sell-off triggered by temporary phase trial delays. The balance sheet remains heavily capitalized with $8.71 in cash per share, giving a 61.3% cash cushion that severely limits insolvency risk during clinical development.
risks: FDA clinical hold or regulatory review extensions.
High R&D cash burn rate reducing CPS over next 4 quarters.

SEDG.name: SolarEdge Technologies, Inc.
SEDG.catalyst: European inverter channel inventory clearance recalibration.
SEDG.thesis: Severe supply chain over-inventory in European distribution channels caused revenue compression. However, SolarEdge's balance sheet maintains a robust $6.50 CPS (54.8% cushion), providing ample time to clear distributor inventory without debt dilution.
risks: Extended high-interest-rate environment slowing residential solar adoption.

PAGS.name: PagSeguro Digital Ltd.
PAGS.catalyst: LatAm FX translation repricing & quarterly volume update.
PAGS.thesis: Short-term currency translation volatility hit foreign investor sentiment. Fundamentals remain intact with strong payment volume growth and net margin expansion.
risks: Brazilian real currency fluctuations against USD.
Central bank interest rate decisions in key South American markets.

RUN.name: Sunrun Inc.
RUN.catalyst: Utility rate case regulatory overhang & storage attachment growth.
RUN.thesis: Regulatory changes around net metering created near-term friction, but shifting sales strategy toward battery storage integration is expanding margins per subscriber.
risks: State-level regulatory changes to solar incentives.
Higher capital costs for installation financing.

LUMN.name: Lumen Technologies, Inc.
LUMN.catalyst: Fiber buildout CAPEX timing recalibration & enterprise AI connectivity expansion.
LUMN.thesis: Turnaround play focused on expanding fiber connectivity for hyperscale data centers. Cash cushion exceeds the 30% gate floor, supporting ongoing debt restructuring.
risks: Legacy copper revenue decline outpacing fiber growth.
Substantial total debt load requiring refinancing.
